news.title: They wrote another "drama of the final showdown"! The South Korean women's football team dramatically advanced to the Round of 16 at the U20 World Cup... with a 3-2 victory over Ecuador.
news.lede: The South Korean U20 women's football team, which had been pushed to the brink of elimination in the group stage, has once again written a dramatic final showdown story. Led by head coach Park Yoon-jeong, South Korea defeated Ecuador 3-2 in the final Group C match of the 2026 FIFA U20 Women's World Cup held at the Łódź Stadium in Poland on the 13th (Korean time). Earlier, after drawing 1-1 with France and losing 1-3 to Ghana in their second match, South Korea had been pushed to the brink of elimination. However, a victory over Ecuador propelled them directly to second place in the group and secured their spot in the Round of 16.

news.title: Viral World Cup fan 'Freddy' back in US. See his Cy-Hawk experience
news.lede: A German sports fan who went captured the nation's attention during the World Cup has returned to the United States, and he's right here in Iowa today. The social-media personality behind the popular X account @FreddyLA7 went viral during the World Cup for his reaction to and love for all things American as he traveled the country. Now, he's returned to the States for something that is quintessentially American — college football. His college football tour seems to have started in Iowa for Week 2 of the 2026 season.

news.title: Paraguay FA backs Gustavo Alfaro through 2030 World Cup
news.lede: Sharjah24: Argentine coach Gustavo Alfaro will remain in charge of Paraguay’s national football team until the 2030 FIFA World Cup after reaching an agreement to extend his contract for another four years. Alfaro earns renewed confidenceQuestions had surrounded the future of the coach who guided “La Albirroja” back to the World Cup in the North American edition, following their elimination by France in the round of 16. It was Paraguay’s first World Cup appearance since the 2010 tournament in South Africa.Announcing the contract extension, Paraguayan Football Association President Robert Harrison wrote on Instagram: “2030, here we go!”

news.title: New Zealand bow out of FIFA U-20 Women’s World Cup after big loss
news.lede: New Zealand have ended their FIFA U-20 Women’s World Cup campaign after being overwhelmed 9-0 by the United States in Poland. The Junior Football Ferns went into their final Group D match at Arena Sosnowiec needing a positive result to retain hopes of reaching the knockout stages, as one of the best-performing third-placed teams. Instead, they met a United States side who produced their strongest performance of the tournament after taking only one point from their opening two matches. Main photo: United States … recovered their campaign with a big win against New Zealand.

news.title: Danny Jordaan re-elected as South Africa FA chief despite fraud charges
news.lede: AP AP https://ss-i.thgim.com/public/incoming/jero9j/article71461042.ece/alternates/FREE_1200/FIFA_Investigation_South_Africa.JPEG-0ac09.jpg THEMBA HADEBE File - Danny Jordaan speaks during a FIFA and Local Organizing Committee press conference, in Johannesburg, South Africa, in this Friday, June 12, 2009 file photo. A South African newspaper on Friday June 5 2015, published a 2007 letter linking the country’s chief World Cup organizer to a $10 million payment made to projects linked to Jack Warner, then a FIFA executive and now a suspect in a corruption probe. In the letter published by the Mail and Guardian newspaper, Danny Jordaan, then head of South Africa’s World Cup organizing committee, says the money should be paid by FIFA, not the South African government.

news.title: Folarin Balogun’s Red Card Scandal Is Still Haunting USMNT Star Months After World Cup
news.lede: Belgium fullback Thomas Meunier looked back on the Folarin Balogun red card saga from this summer’s World Cup and revealed the situation resulted in “everyone” wanting the U.S. men’s national team to be eliminated in the round of 16. Balogun, who had a breakout summer leading Mauricio Pochettino’s line, was controversially sent off in the Stars and Stripes’ round of 32 win over Bosnia and Herzegovina. The red card came with a suspension for the striker until FIFA made the unprecedented decision to suspend his ban, making Balogun eligible to play against Belgium in the next round.FIFA president Gianni Infantino came under massive fire for the call, especially once U.S. President Donald Trump confirmed he asked the sport’s governing body to review the incident .
